snippet.title: Dave.EXE Early Access Announcement Trailer | New Patron Exclusive Out Now!
snippet.description:
The early access build for Dave.EXE, a DBD inspired horror game, is available to play over on my Patreon! Drain the vending machines, encounter random events and escape the horrors that await you in The Nothingness! Out now, only on Patreon.


Special thanks to Padre for creating and editing this badass trailer! ► https://twitter.com/PadreSnowmizzle


Get Dave.EXE + more over on my Patreon! ► https://www.patreon.com/DaveMicrowavesGames


My Twitter! ► https://twitter.com/The_Toonimator
